conversations.title: Broken arm: cause decides cover; side question about the speaker; back to the pending question

turns.user: Kai broke his arm yesterday. Can we claim for it?
turns.visible:
I’m sorry Kai was hurt. Kai’s SunHaven Family Accident Guard lists a Fracture benefit (per fracture) of S$750 for a child, payable once per fracture confirmed by X-ray and certified by a registered medical practitioner, only for what the policy covers, which depends on how it happened: “This policy covers Bodily Injury caused solely and directly by an Accident. A fracture caused by sickness, disease or a gradual or degenerative condition (such as osteoporosis or a bone tumour) is not covered.”
How did Kai break his arm?

turns.user: Before that, quick question: what is my deductible on my KestrelShield plan?
turns.visible:
Daniel’s KestrelShield Integrated Plan lists a deductible of S$3,500 per policy year for a private hospital.
When you’re ready, here is the question I was on.
How did Kai break his arm?

turns.user: He fell off his bicycle at the park.
turns.visible:
Kai’s SunHaven Family Accident Guard covers bodily injury caused solely and directly by an accident, and says accidents are covered anywhere in the world.
Its Fracture benefit (per fracture) lists S$750 for a child, payable once per fracture confirmed by X-ray and certified by a registered medical practitioner.

conversations.title: Dislocated elbow: a benefit whose condition is evidence (X-ray or MRI), stated conditionally

turns.user: Mei landed badly on her elbow at gymnastics this afternoon and the clinic says it's dislocated. Is that something her PlayWell plan helps with?
turns.visible:
I’m sorry Mei hurt herself. Mei’s PlayWell plan lists a Dislocation benefit (per dislocation) of S$600, payable once per dislocation diagnosed by a registered medical practitioner and confirmed by X-ray or MRI.
Has a registered medical practitioner diagnosed the dislocation and confirmed it by X-ray or MRI?

turns.user: Yes, the doctor at the clinic did an X-ray and it showed the dislocation.
turns.visible: I couldn’t confirm an answer to that from your documents.
